info.description: Government financing cluster: 30 program records feeding the hub, checker, program and browse pages (government financing package, Aug 2026)

entity_type.description: Every program shows who runs it; non-government entities say so in the intro

entity_label.description: Display label for the running entity

type.description: Grants rank above loans in the matcher regardless of amount

repayable.description: Null where the concept does not apply (tax credits)

notable.description: The distinguishing fact that decides success with this program

amount_max.description: Only on confidence VERIFIED programs; unverified amounts never render

eligibility.description: Matcher criteria: revenue_max, years_operating_min/max, startups_eligible, sectors_excluded, provinces, incorporation_required, other

timeline_weeks.description: e.g. '4 to 8'; ranking uses the lower bound

intake_status.description: continuous / seasonal / varies* / VERIFY. VERIFY intake holds the program out of checker results

source_url.description: Primary source only (canada.ca, bdc.ca, provincial sites)

confidence.description: VERIFIED-PRIMARY / VERIFIED-MULTI / VERIFY - render gate for amounts

last_verified.description: Static stamp of an actual check, never auto-dated

page_url.description: Directory entries that resolve to another program page
